translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Asaa Maabaraappe Shaakkiyaa Hanotaa
«Sanggisetteedda woy k'aaratetteedda attuma asay, Med'inaa Godaa shiik'uwaa giddon beettoppo.
«Sharmus'an yeletteedda Asay Med'inaa Godaa asaa maabaraa geloppo; haray atto biide tammantsa yeletaa gakkanawukka, Aa zariyaappe ooninne Med'inaa Godaa asaa maabaraa giddo geloppo.

«Amoona asaa gidina, woy Moo'aaba asaa gidinakka, Med'inaa Godaa asaa maabaraa geloppo; haray atto biide tammantsa yeletaa gakkanawukka, unttunttu asaa gideedda ooninne med'inawukka Med'inaa Godaa asaa maabaraa geloppo.

Ayaw gooppe, hintte Gibs'eppe kesiide hemettishin, unttunttu hinttena katsaannanne haatsaana mokkibeykkino. Hewaadankka, Masp'p'es'oomiyan Patoora giyaa kataman de'iyaa Bi'oora na'aa Balaami hinttena shek'k'ana mala k'as'areeddino.
Med'inaa Goday, hintte S'oossay, Balaami giyaawaa sisanaw koyibeenna; Aa shek'k'aa hinttenttoo anjjoo laammeedda. Ayaw gooppe, Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay hinttena siik'ee.
Hintte de'o laytsaa ubbaan med'inawukka unttunttu saro de'anaadaaninne unttunttu durettanaadan amottoppite.
«Hinttew unttunttu dabbo gidiyaa diraw, Edoomatuwaa kad'iide is's'oppite; k'ay Gibs'etuwaakka is's'oppite. Ayaw gooppe, hintte unttunttu gadiyaan bete gidiide de'eeddita.
Unttunttoo heezzentso yeletaa naanay Med'inaa Godaa asaa maabaraa gelanaw danddayiino.
Olaw Dunkkaaneedda Sa'aa Wogaadan Geeshshan Naagussaa
«Hintte hintte morkkiyaa olanaw kesiide ittisaan kambbuwaa med'd'o wode, hinttena tunissiyaawaappe ubbaappe shaakettite.
K'amma akumuwaan mac'c'a asaana gaketeeddawaa erissiyaa irs's'abay aan de'iyaa ay asaynne de'ooppe, dunkkaaneedda sa'aappe gas'aa kesiide yan gam"o.
Sa'ay omarssiyaa wode, bare bollaa meec'ettiide, lelem"iyaa wode dunkkaaneeddasaa simmo.
«Hintte sheeshshaw uttiyaasaa dunkkaaneedda sa'aappe karenna giigissite.
Sheeshshaw uttiyaasaa bookkanaw zoruwaa hintte olaa miishshaanna gatsi oyk'k'ite; sheeshshaw utti simmiide, ollaan biittaa zaarite.

Ayaw gooppe, Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay hinttena naaganawunne hintte morkkatuwaa hintte kushiyan aatsi immanaw, hintte heeran yaanne haanne hamettee. Hewaan I sheneyiyaabaa ayaanne be'iide, hintteppe wora simmennaadan, hintte heeray geeshsha gidanaw koshshee.
Dumma Dumma Higgetuwaa
«Bare godaappe bak'atiide, neekko yeedda ayiliyaa zaaraade Aa godaw immoppa.
I hintte katamatuwaappe bare koyeeddawan de'o; Aa uk'k'unnoppite.
«Israa'eeliyaa asaappe ooninne attuma gidina, mac'c'a gidinakka, allaga s'oossaw goyinniyaawanttu ootsiyaawaadan, sharmus'iyaawaa gidoppo.

Hewaadankka, attumawaa gidina, mac'c'awunno gidina, sharmus'an demmeedda miishshaa shiik'uwaa gatsanaw Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa golliyaa ahoppino. Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu laa"uwaakka Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay shaattee.
«Ne zare gidiyaa Israa'eeliyaa asaw miishshaa, katsaa gidina harabaa tal"aade dichchaa akkoppa.

Hara biittaa asaappe dichchaa oochchanaw danddayaasa; shin neeni laattanaw geliyaa gadiyaan neeni ootsiyaaban ubbaan Med'inaa Goday ne S'oossay neena anjjana mala, ne zare gidiyaa Israa'eeliyaa asaw dichchaw tal"oppa.
«Med'inaa Godaw, ne S'oossaw, immanaw geppeeddawaa immanaw gam"oppa. Med'inaa Goday ne S'oossay neeni geppeeddawaa kumentsan neeppe koyiyaa diraw, polana d'ayooppe, new nagaraa gidana.
Shin neeni geppana d'ayooppe, hewan new nagaray baawa.
Med'inaa Godaw, ne S'oossaw, immana gaade neeni doonaan haasayeeddawaa ne dosuwaan immana geedda diraw, ne ins's'arssan haasayeeddawaa pola.
«Ne shooruwaa woyniyaa gidduwaana aad'd'iyaa wode, woyniyaappe ne koyeedda keenaa mappe attina, aappe ayaanne ne oyk'k'eedda miishshaan yeggoppa.
Ne shooruwaa shoyk'aanna kantsiyaa wode, he shoyk'aan de'iyaa tishaappe duutsaade mappe attina, ne shooruwaa katsaa baac'aan c'akkaade golle afoppa.
